'''''The Bloody Credit''''' was a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] that was used as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] ship during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
The ''Credit'' was crewed by 18 [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], who were formerly [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and had fought for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nizon]], to transport some [[Nazren]] slaves for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, it was attacked by a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents, who attempted to prevent it from leaving Nizon with its cargo.
